stages.title: Number universe
stages.body: Natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational and real numbers.

stages.title: Divisibility
stages.body: Use prime-factor and digit tests only within their valid base-ten conditions.

stages.title: Primes and factors
stages.body: Factorise before counting divisors or comparing powers.

stages.title: HCF and LCM
stages.body: Use gcd-lcm relations with integer and positivity checks.

stages.title: Remainders
stages.body: Reduce early and preserve the modulus.

stages.title: Unit digits
stages.body: Use cyclicity and treat exponent-zero cases separately.

stages.title: Digits and place value
stages.body: Translate reversal and digit count into base-ten equations.

stages.title: Powers and factorials
stages.body: Use repeated division for prime exponents and trailing zeros.

stages.title: Fractions and decimals
stages.body: Convert recurring forms through algebra, not memorised guesses.

stages.title: Series
stages.body: Test differences, ratios, alternation and position rules.

stages.title: Verification
stages.body: Plug back, check parity, digit count, remainder and order of magnitude.
